title: Differences in the Moral Foundations of Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Administering the Moral Foundations Vignettes (MFV) survey to elicit severity ratings of moral transgressions across six foundations (Care, Fairness, Loyalty, Authority, Sanctity, Liberty), comparing model responses to a human baseline using descriptive statistics and PCA, and performing semantic analysis of foundation-specific language in model justifications.

Mapping the models' preferences for 'individualizing' foundations (Care, Fairness) versus 'binding' foundations (Loyalty, Authority, Sanctity) to established liberal and conservative ideological profiles to detect left-leaning or right-leaning slants in model judgments.
